site.title: Site Directory
site.description:
[relative to root]

The folder containing your SvelteKit site.

sources.title: Source Directories
sources.description:
[relative to root]

Source folders from which to start searching for Markdown files.

include.title: Include Patterns
include.description: Only files whose full path matches against any of these RegEx patterns will be searched.

exclude.title: Exclude Patterns
exclude.description: Files whose full path matches against any of these RegEx patterns will *not* be checked by Squarkdown.

folder.title: Destination Folder
folder.description:
[relative to `paths.site`]

Where to export files relative to.

`destination` paths in files are relative to this folder.

file-name.title: SVX Filename
file-name.description: The file name for exported files, including the (expected) `.svx` extension.

site-data-path.title: Site Data Filepath
site-data-path.description:
[relative to `paths.site`]

Where to export site data, including the (expected) `.json` extension.

If absent, site data is not exported.

shorter-fields.title: Shorter Field Names
shorter-fields.description:
Should fields in exported `+page.ts` and `site.json` use more compact identifiers?

For instance, `description` is shortened to `desc`, and `last_update` is shortened to `update`.

folder.title: Assets Folder
folder.description:
[relative to root]

The folder from which to copy assets to `site/static/`.

site-assets-folder.title: Site Assets Folder
site-assets-folder.description:
[relative to root]

A folder (possibly inside `assets.folder`) from which to copy assets directly to `site/static/` without any nested structure.

strict.title: Enable Safety Checks
strict.description:
Enable stricter checks for safety?

This includes:

- Requiring [`PageData.destination`](crate::types::PageData::destination) to be explicitly provided
Checking directories remain under your project root
Checking multiple files don't export to the same directory

on-error.title: Error Handling
on-error.description: What to do when a non-fatal error is encountered (e.g. parsing a file failed).

file-already-exists.title: File Conflict Handling
file-already-exists.description: What to do when a target file to write to already exists.

broken-link.title: Inactive Link Handling
broken-link.description: When rendering Markdown, how should Squarkdown handle a link that points to an inactive file?
